title: Deprecate DataEngineQueryOptions, converge Engine/Protocol/Client to QueryAST standard parameters
body:
The data layer maintained two parallel parameter vocabularies — `DataEngineQueryOptions` (filter/select/sort/skip/populate) at the Engine layer and `QueryAST` (where/fields/orderBy/offset/expand) at the Driver layer — with a mechanical `toQueryAST()` translation between them. This added zero semantic value while creating maintenance debt and `as any` proliferation across Protocol/Client/SDK/Hooks.

This PR eliminates the translation layer by making the Engine accept QueryAST-standard parameters directly.

### Spec schemas (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`)
- New QueryAST-aligned schemas: `EngineQueryOptionsSchema`, `EngineUpdateOptionsSchema`, `EngineDeleteOptionsSchema`, `EngineAggregateOptionsSchema`, `EngineCountOptionsSchema`
- Old `DataEngine*` schemas marked `@deprecated`, kept for backward compat
- RPC request schemas (`DataEngineFindRequestSchema`, etc.) accept **both** new and legacy parameter names via shared `RpcLegacyFilterMixin` and `RpcQueryOptionsSchema` — legacy payloads are validated rather than silently stripped
- `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema`: `filter`→`where`, `select`→`fields`
- Aggregate: `method`→`function` (aligns with `AggregationNodeSchema`)

### IDataEngine interface (`packages/spec` + `packages/core`)
- `find`/`findOne` accept `EngineQueryOptions` (where/fields/orderBy/offset/expand)
- `update`/`delete` accept `EngineUpdateOptions`/`EngineDeleteOptions` (where instead of filter)
- `count`/`aggregate` accept `EngineCountOptions`/`EngineAggregateOptions`

### Engine implementation (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`)
- **Removed `toQueryAST()`** — the entire translation layer is gone
- `find`/`findOne` spread query directly into QueryAST: `{ object, ...query }`
- `find` normalizes OData `top` → `limit` before calling the driver
- `update`/`delete` extract ID from `options.where` using proper `'id' in options.where` type narrowing (no `as any` casts or unreachable string-ID branches)
- `aggregate` passes `query.aggregations` directly (no method→function remapping)

### Protocol handler (`packages/objectql/src/protocol.ts`)
- `findData` normalizes all legacy HTTP params to QueryAST in one pass:
  - `filter`/`filters`/`$filter` → `where`
  - `select` → `fields`
  - `sort`/`orderBy` → `orderBy`
  - `skip` → `offset`
  - `top` → `limit`
  - `populate`/`expand`/`$expand` → `expand` (Record<string, QueryAST>)
- Fixed populate/expand precedence: non-object `expand` is cleaned up before populate-to-Record conversion, so `populate` names are preserved even when a legacy string `expand` is also present

### Client SDK (`packages/client`)
- `QueryOptions` and `find()` marked `@deprecated`, recommend `query()` with `Partial<QueryAST>`

### Downstream consumers
- `plugin-auth`, `runtime/seed-loader`, `studio/broker-shim` updated to use QueryAST parameters
- Documentation (`data-engine.mdx`) updated
- Changeset added (`.changeset/queryast-convergence.md`)

> <issue_title>架构统一：废除 DataEngineQueryOptions，Engine/Protocol/Client 全面收敛到 QueryAST 标准参数</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 问题现状
> ObjectStack 数据协议目前存在两套接入参数命名体系：
> - Engine 层/协议参数为 DataEngineQueryOptions（filter/sort/top/skip/populate）
> - Driver 层/真正底层只认标准 QueryAST（where/orderBy/limit/offset/expand ...）
> - Engine 层维护手动转换逻辑（toQueryAST），Protocol/Client 需各类 alias 适配，增加维护负债
> 
> ### 不良后果
> - 代码分层间存在纯粹的机械转译，无任何语义增值，易出错，工程复杂度上升
> - Protocol/Client 不断需要兼容两套词汇（filter/orderBy, skip/offset, sort/orderBy），`as any` 泛滥
> - Hooks/插件/SDK/测试数据/低代码平台全都及其容易混淆
> 
> ## 目标
> 系统所有入口（protocol、engine、client）只接受标准 QueryAST（where/orderBy/limit/offset/expand ...），彻底停止 DataEngineQueryOptions 相关 alias。
> 
> ## 路线建议
> 
> **A. Engine 层接口切换**
> - `IDataEngine.find/findOne`/update/delete... 统一全部参数为 QueryAST
> - 所有 toQueryAST 类型转换工具删除
> - DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema 标记为 deprecated
> 
> **B. Protocol 层参数吸收统一**
> - 接收到任何 legacy query param（filter/sort/top/skip/orderBy...）时，只做升级合并到 QueryAST 一处
> - 全协议只用 QueryAST
> 
> **C. Client SDK 更新**
> - 推荐 client.data.query() 作为唯一 API，参数就是 QueryAST（官方统一 QueryBuilder 输出即 IR）
> - client.data.find() 等历史方法加 deprecated 注释，内部仅做兼容适配
> 
> **D. 工具链统一**
> - 文档与前端模版同步收敛 QueryAST
> - 代码生成、低代码平台生成的 CRUD/query 代码直接吐出标准 IR
> </issue_description>
